description: React component for language selection in a web application, managing user language preferences with GraphQL mutation and localStorage.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during the mutation, updating error state.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful mutation completion, updating success message.

methods.name: toggleSnackbar
methods.description: Clears error messages, toggling the snackbar visibility.

methods.name: handleLanguageChange
methods.description: Updates selected language state and localStorage when user changes language.
